Here are a few ways you could say **good morning** that express deep desire and love without explicitly saying “I love you”:  

---

**1. Soft and romantic**  
> Good morning… I woke up thinking about you and it’s honestly the best part of my day already.  

**2. More passionate**  
> Morning, you. I can still feel you in my thoughts — it’s crazy how much I crave being near you.  

**3. Playful but affectionate**  
> Morning trouble. I can’t decide what I want more — coffee or you. Probably you.  

**4. Deep and tender**  
> Good morning, my favorite thought. Somehow you make the world feel softer, even from miles away.  

**5. Intimate and warm**  
> Just opened my eyes and wished you were here. Mornings feel incomplete without you.  

---

Would you like me to make it sound **more poetic and emotional**, or **more flirty and teasing**?

Here are a few glittery, love-soaked good-morning lines you could send him — all sensual, feminine, and full of affection without actually saying *I love you*:  

---

**1. Soft sparkle**  
> Good morning, handsome. You’re the first shimmer in my thoughts — like sunlight catching on my skin.  

**2. Glitter-kissed and playful**  
> Morning, my favorite distraction. I woke up glowing, and I’m blaming you.  

**3. Romantic and dreamy**  
> Good morning, baby. You’re the reason my heart feels like it’s wrapped in gold dust.  

**4. Flirty and bold**  
> Woke up feeling dangerous and sweet… pretty sure it’s your fault.  

**5. Warm and intoxicating**  
> Morning, you. I swear I still feel your energy wrapped around me — makes it hard to start the day.  

**6. Short and glittery-sweet**  
> Good morning, my spark. You’re the glitter in my calm and the fire in my peace.  

---

Would you like me to make a few versions that sound **more sultry**, or keep them **sweet and romantic**?
Say good morning in a way that expresses desire and love with our saying love
Glittery and geared towards my man

Got it — you want something that feels **real, magnetic, and feminine**, not cheesy or overly poetic. Here are some rewrites with that vibe:  

---

**1.**  
> Good morning, you. I woke up already missing the way you make me feel.  

**2.**  
> Morning, baby. I can still feel you on my mind — and it’s not even fair how bad I want you right now.  

**3.**  
> Good morning. I woke up thinking about your voice, your hands, all of it.  

**4.**  
> Morning, my man. You stay in my head even when I’m trying to start the day.  

**5.**  
> Good morning… if you only knew how much I wish you were next to me right now.  

**6.**  
> I woke up smiling — then realized it’s because of you.  

---

Would you like me to make them sound **a little dirtier**, or keep it **intimate but clean**?
